args.question: Why the way to it is closed?

replies.text: The go command for the kitchen (event 4) was refused by go_closed[P=kitchen] because the kitchen is mapped but closed(kitchen) holds, and it has held since the base state. Nothing in the run closed it. To set off, the world needed open(kitchen), and the dog would also have to be standing first since it is sitting.

resource.words: an open way to the kitchen

args.question: Why I am already busy with a task?

replies.text: The search for the keys was refused by find_busy[T=keys,P=tag3] (event 10) because the dog was still on its way to tag3. Event 8, go[P=tag3], used up idle and left moving(tag3), so the find move had no idle to start from. The dog has to arrive, be stopped or be cancelled before it can search.

resource.words: being free of any other task (idle)

args.question: Why there is a wall right there?

replies.text: No move put the wall there: wall(backward) has been in the world since the base state (#init), and none of the 14 events produced it. When you asked the dog to move backward, it needed a clear way that direction. The world only has clear(forward), so with wall(backward) present it refused at event 14, move_wall[W=backward].

The model has no reason for the extinguisher being locked away: locked_away(extinguisher) was added from outside at step 19 ('do +locked_away(extinguisher)'), and no move in the dog's script produces it. The model only shows what happened next: at event 20, find_locked[T=extinguisher] ended the search that find[T=extinguisher] had started at event 16, and the dog said 'I can't reach it: it is locked away.'

args.question: Why it is not something I can or may do?

replies.text: Event 26 was the unknown move, which fired on the command alone. The command came in as cmd unknown, and this move requires nothing else from the world. It is the fixed reply for any request outside the dog's repertoire: no state was lacking, so no missing resource explains it.

args.question: Why the battery is too low to search?

replies.text: The search command was refused at event 30 (find_low[T=bottle]). The find move needs battery_ok, and the world has battery_low but no battery_ok. battery_low was last produced by event 29, which comes after the earlier find at event 16 that ran while battery_ok still held.

args.question: Why I have to stand up first?

replies.text: Turning needs me to be standing, but I am sitting: event 32 left me in posture(sitting), so the turn came out as turn_must_stand at event 34. The way to my left is free (free(left)), so standing is the only thing missing. Also note that my battery is now low (battery_low), so a stand command would currently be refused as stand_low.
